findings.claim: The external-source verifier still hashes the mutable working tree rather than the pinned Git commit, so a dirty worktree can satisfy HEAD equality without proving the files came from that immutable revision.
findings.evidence: The blocking `realtime-contract-source-integrity` constraint requires external source files whose Git HEAD and SHA-256 digests match the pinned contract, but `verifyExternalSources` only checks `git rev-parse --verify HEAD^{commit}` and then computes hashes from `readFile(join(root, path))`; it never hashes `HEAD:<path>` or requires `git status`/the pinned files to be clean.
findings.suggested_fix: Hash each file from the pinned commit with `git -C <root> show HEAD:<path>` or require the worktree/index to be clean for every pinned file before hashing filesystem contents.
